content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Director-General position at the International Atomic Energy Agency. Tell about your experience in nuclear safety, monitoring the Non-Proliferation Treaty, and peaceful use of nuclear technology. Describe your vision for the IAEA's role in nuclear disarmament and combating climate change through nuclear power. Length about 450 words.
